SYNTHETIC: this report page is invented for Ratio's tests. No real person, court or trial is described.

The monitor followed the trial of Rafe Corran, a radio presenter, who was charged with defamation of a public official after a broadcast about the award of a road contract.

Pre-trial detention

He was held for nine days before he first saw a judge. At the remand hearing his lawyer was absent, and the order extending his detention repeated the words of the previous order.

The prosecution relied on one witness.

The defence was not allowed to call its expert.

The court gave no reasons for refusing the defence’s request to examine the recording.
The judgment was read out in a closed session & was not published.
